title: Wonderful Partner for a Confidential Executive Career Transition
content:
★★★★★ | Anonymous candidate-submitted review
Submitted May 10, 2026

Balancing a demanding full-time role with a senior-level job search is no small task. I began looking discreetly in mid-December 2025, and protecting my privacy throughout the process was essential. I wanted a partner who understood the North American market and could help me explore it quietly. Working with KOV Career Agency made that possible. Over about five months, they helped me build momentum while I stayed focused on my current job, and I recently moved into a Head of Marketing role.

I also appreciated KOV’s open-fee model. Traditional executive search firms often charge a percentage of salary, which can create competing incentives during negotiations. KOV’s approach felt more transparent and collaborative. I had practical support as I considered and finalized my contract terms, and the relationship felt like a genuine partnership.

KOV’s proactive outreach stood out. Rather than depending on job boards or submitting my resume into automated systems, the team contacted decision-makers and hiring leads at organizations we had targeted. That approach helped me keep my search private at my current company while opening conversations with potential employers across the region.

This is an active, collaborative process, not a search you can leave on autopilot. The outreach led to many conversations and interview opportunities, so I needed to stay engaged, review strategy with my advisor, and respond promptly when employers got in touch. Keeping up with the pace took real discipline.

For marketing leaders and other executives considering a move while still employed, it helps to give the process time and stay involved. The resume work, mock interviews, and strategic positioning helped me feel more prepared for employer conversations. I’d recommend KOV to senior professionals looking for a thoughtful, confidential career transition.
